title: Nutty Crispy Ethiopian Fish Tacos
description: A fatty and crispy Ethiopian dish featuring pink food coloring and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a sick day, pescatarian-friendly fish tacos with a twist.
instructions: Rinse the cod fillets and cut them into small pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the pink food coloring and kombu-cold-extract to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Toss the cod pieces in the bowl to coat them evenly with the flour mixture.
Heat the peanut oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the cod pieces in batches until they are golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fried cod on paper towels and sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the crispy cod in taco shells and enjoy.
